CreateJob.description_zh: 创建一个E-HPC Instant 作业

DeleteJobRecords.description_en: Deletes one or more job records in the desired state from a specified cluster
DeleteJobRecords.description_zh: 删除指定集群中一个或多个处于终态的作业记录

DeleteJobs.description_en: Deletes one or more jobs from a specified cluster
DeleteJobs.description_zh: 删除指定集群中一个或多个作业

DescribeJobMetricData.description_en: You can query the monitoring time series dataset of a job by specifying the job array index and query metric parameters
DescribeJobMetricData.description_zh: 通过指定特定作业数组索引及查询监控项参数，查询作业的监控时序数据集

DescribeJobMetricLast.description_en: Queries all instant monitoring metrics in the job array list by specifying a specific job array index list
DescribeJobMetricLast.description_zh: 通过指定特定的作业数组索引列表，查询作业数组列表下的所有即时监控指标

GetActionPlan.description_en: Queries the details of an execution plan

GetJob.description_en: Retrieves the details of a job

GetJobRecordDuration.description_en: Retrieves the job record retention period

GetPool.description_en: Retrieves the details of a resource pool

ListActionPlanActivities.description_en: Queries the execution status of an execution plan
ListActionPlanActivities.description_zh: 查询执行计划的执行情况

ListActionPlans.description_en: Queries the list of execution plans

ListExecutorEvents.description_en: Queries the runtime event list of one or more Executors
ListExecutorEvents.description_zh: 查询一个或多个Executor的运行事件列表

ListJobExecutors.description_en: Queries the executor information of a job

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are bound to one or more Instant resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个Instant资源已经绑定的标签列表

TagResources.description_en: Create and bind tags to Instant resource list
TagResources.description_zh: 为Instant资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UnTagResources.description_en: Unbinds tags from a list of Instant resources in a unified manner. After a tag is unbound, if it is not bound to any other resources, the tag is automatically deleted
UnTagResources.description_zh: 为Instant资源列表统一解绑标签。解绑后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何资源，会被自动删除

UpdateActionPlan.description_en: Adjust the resource scale of the execution plan or modify the execution status
UpdateActionPlan.description_zh: 调整执行计划资源规模或执行修改状态

UpdatePool.description_en: Updates the configuration of a resource pool
